**Finding 1 (high, security — `javascript:` href injection):** Added `_SAFE_URL_SCHEMES = ("http://", "https://")` and a `_safe_href(url)` allowlist helper at `report_html.py`. The two interpolation sites that emitted `<a href="{fix_url}">` (whats-next panel and per-probe card) now route through a new `_render_docs_line(fix_url)` helper: if `_safe_href` accepts the URL, it renders as an active anchor; otherwise the URL is rendered as inert escaped text in `<span class="docs-unsafe">` (line-through styling) so the operator still sees the rejected value but the document cannot execute it. Three regression tests added: `test_6d_javascript_url_in_fix_url_is_not_rendered_as_active_href`, `test_6e_data_url_in_fix_url_is_inert`, and `test_6f_https_fix_url_renders_as_active_link` (confirms the allowlist does not over-block legitimate http/https links).
